title: 16-Inch Double Glass Shelf With Gallery Rail (Wall Mount) | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
body_html:
Need more bathroom storage without crowding the vanity? This wall-mounted double glass shelf adds two levels of organized space and keeps daily essentials right where you reach for them in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom.

  • Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Coordinates with other Waverly Place pieces for a distinguished, heritage-inspired look
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Coordinate your space with the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place, transitional bath accessories, and transitional bathroom hardware.
  • Clean, finished installation using concealed screw mounting hardware and included installation hardware.

Specs & Installation

  • Glass dimensions (each shelf): 16 x 5 inches
  • Overall size: 16 in L x 8 in H x 5 in projection
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Materials: solid brass hardware with tempered glass shelves
  • Mounting: wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: glass shelf set and all installation hardware (#8 x 1 1/4" screws)
  • multiple designer finish options available
